getAll.sql: SELECT userId, username, money FROM Users

getById.sql: SELECT userId, username, money FROM Users WHERE userId = $userId
getById.description: Gets a user by primary key

create.sql: INSERT INTO Users(username, password, money) VALUES ($username, $password, 0)
create.description: Crea un usuario nuevo con saldo 0

update.sql: UPDATE Users SET username = $username, password = $password, money = $money WHERE userId = $userId
update.description: Updates an existing entry in 'Users' by primary key

delete.description: Deletes an existing entry in 'Users' by primary key
